doc.name: Phantom
doc.description:
Sky Pods, created by  A0K1VERSE, in collaboration with oncyber and Inferstudio, are the next step into the A0K1 metaverse. 
The pods represent a virtual home that can be used to display art, listen to music, and gather with friends. 
The Phantom Sky Pod features a gallery ring with room to display 35 works, multi-level living spaces, a gravity-defying pool, and a mixing studio with a performance platform and open-plan floor area. Phantom pods fuse the typologies of apartment and art gallery, with an interior design that is completely distinct from the preceding passport tiers. A variety of nooks, shelves, and curved walls can accommodate vast and diverse digital art collections and the interior spaces are textured in dramatic charcoal blacks, with incorporated sub-surface scattering materials. 
These pods also feature oncyber’s Physically Based Rendering (PBR) material system allowing for realtime dynamic reflections, reflecting the concept that in virtual worlds it is computational complexity rather than physical properties that determines material value. The Phantom pods are suspended amidst surrounding high altitude clouds, and at night they reveal tinges of a green aurora under a starry sky.

doc.name: Infinite Museum
doc.description:
Designed by Architect Dan Brunn, Outland Art presents the Infinite Museum, centered on highlighting multidisciplinary visual artist James Jean’s Fragments, a series of hand-drawn digital artworks inspired by a forthcoming large-scale, luminous architectural pavilion by the artist, titled Pagoda, that will be composed of 7,000 stained glass pieces. 

The experience emphasizes the individuality of the Fragments series at a singular level, and as a whole, as part of vast collection.  Also, being our first metaverse design, we wanted to create something familiar, yet harness the new possibilities of weightlessness.  From the onset, it was vital to balance between the physical limitations of earth, and the metaverse.  With gravity is no longer a barrier to design, new forms and spaces can be created

At the center of it all Pagoda, gently touching down on the lush landscape.  Sunlight penetrates through with a warm glow in contrast to the clean architectural statement.

By owning the Infinite Museum NFT, collectors can start curating their own exhibition on oncyber.

doc.name: Mauer Church
doc.description:
Visit the space at oncyber.io/destinations/mauerchurch. Church is the fifth block in MAUER. The complex history of religion in divided Berlin ranges from repression and resistance to co-option and infiltration. To symbolize this struggle the space draws its main architectural inspiration from Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church - a striking landmark and a monument against war and destruction. Originally built in the 1890s, a bombing in 1943 caused the main spire to break and the roof to collapse. Architect Egon Eiermann integrated the ruin in his design for the new church completed in 1963. 

MAUER Church consists of concrete honeycomb elements with stained glass inlays. Inside the rectangle nave, the stained glass produces a rich blue light and an atmosphere of meditative calm. 

This spiritual memorial against war and destruction contains 18 showcase points for NFTs and two portal options to connect to other Mauer spaces.

doc.name: PAIworld
doc.description:
Visit the space at oncyber.io/destinations/paiworld. PAI says: "In a virtual world beyond imagination, one that takes you on a journey into the Matrix, lies three galleries on the left, each designed in a futuristic way to hold art on every wall. The galleries are a sight to behold, with sleek lines and a minimalist aesthetic that transport visitors to a different realm.

In between the galleries on the left, there are two gates that appear as if they have time-traveled to become portals in the future realm. These gates are the gateway to the other world, a place where time stands still and art is the only language spoken.

On the right, there is a two-story building that is meant for art on the bottom floor and music on the top floor. The building is a harmonious blend of the past and the future, with a touch of nostalgia and a hint of the unknown.

The outside area is a vast space that is prepared to hold 3D art in between the moving phrase 'TIME IS AN ILLUSION'. In the back area, there is a giant object that rotates back and forth, creating its own force field. Inside the rotating object is an enclosed space with a wall to display art.

On the outer edges of the realm, there was an old-school jumping game, where long floating bricks led visitors to a tunnel that took them to the lower world of the realm. In this lower world, the floating bricks ended with a single brick floating at the bottom of the world, where a single placeholder sat. This art placeholder was truly hard to get, and only the most dedicated and skilled visitors were able to claim it.

This virtual world is a place where art, music, and technology collide, creating a realm where visitors can lose themselves in a world of wonder and imagination. It is a place where time truly is an illusion, and art is the only reality."

doc.name: City of Lights
doc.description:
Visit the space at oncyber.io/destinations/cityoflights. PAI says: "In the Metaverse, a city of light emerges, its ethereal form built upon a vast expanse of water, surrounded by the endless expanse of the starry night sky. Its many rooms, crafted from the very essence of light, hold within them treasures of art.

But the true jewel of the city lies at its edge, towering above the waves. A tower of light, its many rooms stacked one atop the other, beckoning with tunnels that lead to untold wonders. Each room, a testament to art's greatness, a hallowed space where a singular masterpiece can be savored in isolation.

And yet, this marvel is no mere playground for the wealthy elite. Nay, it is a limited edition of 55 galleries, each purchase an act of benevolence. For all revenue is pledged to the noble cause of thequestioneers.com, an organization with a noble mission: to provide cameras and classes to the world's children, that they too may learn of art's power and connect with one another through intercultural creativity.

In this city of light, in this tower of wonder, art and altruism combine. And the world is better for it."

doc.name: Castle Degenaissance (Pyne Castle)
doc.description:
Visit the space at oncyber.io/destinations/castledegenaissance(pynecastle). Welcome to Castle Degenaissance, passionately crafted by Art Unchained as a Digital Twin of the iconic Pyne Castle in Laguna Beach, California.

The exterior of Castle Degenaissance is an authentic replica, capturing every nook and cranny of Pyne Castle's timeless architecture. We've left no stone unturned—virtually, of course—to bring you an experience that echoes the grandeur and majesty of the original structure.

As you cross the threshold, prepare for a digital renaissance. While the exterior pays homage to the past, the interior is a futuristic landscape teeming with innovation. Think of it as a symbiosis between reality and the digital space, where modernity and tradition coalesce to offer you an unparalleled experience.

And what would a castle be without its royal gallery? Elliott, the owner, has curated an exceptional exhibition of digital art that not only reflects his taste but also serves as a testament to the endless possibilities of the digital realm. From VR experiences to interactive storytelling, the gallery is a treasure trove that promises to surprise and inspire.

Beyond the art, Castle Degenaissance will also be a hub for all kinds of events that bring the virtual and real worlds into a seamless union. 

Come explore Castle Degenaissance and immerse yourself in a world where every corner is a fusion of the traditional and the futuristic, made possible by Art Unchained.
